name: GSTR-3B Summary (Shelf)
query: select company_gstin as "GSTIN:Data:180", sum(base_net_total) as "Taxable Value:Currency:140", sum(total_taxes_and_charges) as "Tax:Currency:120" from `tabSales Invoice` where docstatus = 1 and company = %(company)s and posting_date between %(from_date)s and %(to_date)s group by company_gstin
